turns.insight: Closing-count inconsistency left uncorrected: states "5 new reminders" while the table lists six contacts, and Jordan's reported ID matches a reminder already on the device.

findings.title: City inference rests entirely on area codes
findings.body: Every distance depends on mapping the phone area code to a city (646/917/347→NYC, 312→Chicago, 415→SF). This is never cross-checked against any location field, so a VoIP or ported number would silently produce a wrong distance.

findings.title: Timezone of reused timing contexts is handled loosely
findings.body: Existing reminders store wall-clock phrasing ("2 PM", "6:30 PM") but the agent creates new reminders at the same number as a UTC hour. For Daniel the agent itself noted the stored timestamp mapped to 01:00 UTC yet still created at 14:00 UTC — an uncorrected local-vs-UTC conflation.

findings.title: Recap count is internally inconsistent
findings.body: The closing recap claims "All 5 new reminders were created" but the table lists six contacts, and Jordan's row ID (a56b61e1…) matches a reminder already present on the device — so at least one "created/confirmed" entry may be a pre-existing record.
